variants.headline: Still in view: home world punishes the colony
variants.sub: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has punished the colony. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the punishment without assigning a particular form to it. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
